title: providers.json
description: What a repository declares about who governs it: .agenticframework/providers.json (contract/gate/v1/protocol.md). A port this version does not read is ignored, so declaring one early costs nothing.

contract.description: The contract version this repository speaks. A provider's own version moves independently.

gate.description: Who answers the three gate events, or "none": this repository declares itself ungoverned, and the hooks do nothing rather than fall back to whatever is installed.

command.description: The command to run, as a shell word list: `agentsmith gate`, `mygov gate --quiet`. It is run with the event appended and the payload on stdin.

version.description: The provider versions this repository expects, as a range. Recorded for a person and for tooling; the launcher does not enforce it.
